events.title: Award Goals
events.description: Members can now earn awards by completing specific goals; six goal awards are available initially with more to come.

events.title: Cancel Active Contracts
events.description: Members can now cancel active contracts only if both parties agree; otherwise the contract remains active.

events.title: MoTM Automation
events.description: Member of the Month awards will now be granted automatically on the first of each month based on Popularity points. The winner receives a PM and a thread is auto-created by Help Bot.

events.title: Alerts & Notifications poll
events.description: A poll asked members whether they prefer an on-site alert system or push notifications.

events.title: New Profile Design
events.description: A new member profile page design is under development; members were invited to vote on changes.

events.title: Game Tab Overhauled
events.description: The Game Tab was completely overhauled, with everything organized by Category and Genre.
